row.evidence: Whimsical's pricing page lists SAML Single Sign-On and SCIM as included only on Business ($20/editor/mo), not on Free or Pro ($10/editor/mo); the help centre says SCIM is on the Business plan.
row.notes: New row. SCIM and SAML both start at Business ($20 per editor/mo annual) vs Pro $10, so the SCIM tax is 2.0x. Viewers are free; pricing is per editor. SCIM requires SAML to be configured, and disabling SAML disables SCIM. SCIM deprovisioning removes the user from the workspace; with User offboarding enabled their Private files move after 72 hours. No group push; roles limited to editor/viewer via a custom 'editor' attribute, admin cannot be set via SCIM. Provisioned users are only created once they first sign in via SAML ('pending'). The public API is a read-only, invite-only beta. Google Workspace: SAML only, no SCIM; OneLogin SCIM is 'Contact us'.

auth.token_source: Workspace Settings > enable SCIM provisioning > Reveal (OAuth token)
auth.notes: Microsoft's tutorial says long-lived bearer token authentication is supported; Whimsical states no expiry.

deprovision.data_retained: Content in shared folders stays accessible to collaborators; with User offboarding (Business) enabled, the user's Private files move to a chosen private team after 72 hours.

custom.how: Custom 'editor' boolean attribute (Okta: 'Workspace Editor') sets editor (true) or viewer (false)

attributes.notes: Entra tutorial lists userName, externalId, active, displayName; given/family name are set only at creation; email changes sync only within the same or a verified domain.

roles.how: editor/viewer via custom 'editor' attribute, set per group assignment in Okta; admin role cannot be set via SCIM

limitations.text: Group fetching and group provisioning are not supported.
Given and family name can only be updated by the user after creation.
Disabling SAML disables SCIM; users must be re-imported after re-enabling.
Accounts are created only when the provisioned user first signs in via SAML (pending until then).
Email addresses must be sent in lower case (Okta).
JumpCloud cannot send the custom editor attribute, so JumpCloud-provisioned users default to editor; JumpCloud group management must be turned off.
Google Workspace is SAML-only (no SCIM); OneLogin and other IdPs SCIM is 'Contact us'.
Beta, read-only, access by approval only (no guaranteed acceptance); OAuth 2.1 secrets issued by Whimsical.

user_api.notes: Recorded as partner_only because access is by beta approval; RPC-style POST endpoints, base URL not documented.

okta.notes: OIN page markup marks SAML, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate as checked (not Group Push).

google.notes: From Whimsical's own provider table (SAML yes, SCIM no); Google catalogue not checked.

onelogin.notes: Whimsical's OneLogin guide uses the generic SAML Custom Connector (Advanced); SCIM for OneLogin is 'Contact us'.
